I have resolved the proxy authentication issue.

### Cause of the Issue
When proxy URLs contain credentials (e.g. `user:pass@proxy:8080`), `prepend_scheme_if_needed()` previously used `urllib3.util.parse_url()` to construct the URL with scheme. Because `urllib3.util.parse_url().netloc` returns only `host:port` (excluding the user credentials in `auth`), `urlunparse` stripped `user:pass@` from the proxy URL. Additionally, URLs without an explicit `http://` scheme (e.g., `user:pass@proxy:8080`) were parsed incorrectly by `urlparse` in Python 3.8.12+ due to changes in scheme parsing, causing proxy credentials and `Proxy-Authorization` headers to be omitted.

### Solution
1. **[requests/utils.py](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-o0m3z53t/requests/utils.py#L960-L1000)**:
   - Updated [`prepend_scheme_if_needed`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-o0m3z53t/requests/utils.py#L960) to preserve credentials in proxy URLs and properly prepend schemes without stripping authentication.
   - Updated [`get_auth_from_url`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-o0m3z53t/requests/utils.py#L985) to ensure scheme prepending is applied so credentials in URLs without scheme prefixes are parsed correctly.
2. **[requests/sessions.py](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-o0m3z53t/requests/sessions.py#L293-L298)**:
   - Fixed [`Session.rebuild_proxies`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-o0m3z53t/requests/sessions.py#L272) to set the `Proxy-Authorization` header whenever `username` is present (aligning with `HTTPAdapter.proxy_headers`).
